#Module dom

The document tree (DOM Standard: Document, Node, Element). In a worker there is no document: the functions taking a node see no live node, and those returning one return null.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/dom.widl.

#Types

#handle Node : EventTarget

A node of the document. A node created by the module and never inserted lives until Node_release.

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_Node).

#handle Element : Node

A node that is an element.

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_Element).

#struct DomRect

A rectangle (DOMRect).

fieldtype
xf64
yf64
widthf64
heightf64

#struct SelectionState

The document's selection.

fieldtype
anchoru64
anchor_offsetu32
focusu64
focus_offsetu32
kindu320 none, 1 caret (collapsed), 2 range

#CustomElements_define

void CustomElements_define(string name)

customElements.define(name, ...) succeeded: elements of that local name now queue reactions.

Host: CustomElements_define :: proc(c: ^Call, name: string)

#CustomElements_pending

u32 CustomElements_pending()

The size CustomElements_take needs now (0: nothing queued): the engine sizes its buffer with it, as the take empties the queue (it must not be called twice to learn its size).

Host: CustomElements_pending :: proc(c: ^Call) -> u32

#CustomElements_take

bytes CustomElements_take()

The queued reactions, taken: per reaction u8 kind (1 upgrade, 2 connected, 3 disconnected, 4 attribute changed) and u64 element; an attribute change adds its name, old value and new value (u32 length + UTF-8 each) and a u8 of flags (1: there was an old value, 2: there is a new one). Each element stays pinned until CustomElements_release.

Host: CustomElements_take :: proc(c: ^Call) -> []u8

#CustomElements_release

void CustomElements_release(u64[] elements)

The engine wrapped the elements of the last take (its wrappers pin them now).

Host: CustomElements_release :: proc(c: ^Call, elements: []u64)

#Collection_create

Object Collection_create(Node root, i32 kind, string arg) raises

A live collection. Kinds: 0 child nodes, 1 child elements, 2 elements by qualified name (arg; "" all), 3 by class names (arg), 4 by name attribute (arg), 5 forms, 6 images, 7 links (a and area with href), 8 scripts, 9 embeds, 10 anchors (a with name), 11 elements by namespace and local name (arg: namespace, NUL, local name; "" any), 12 all elements, 13 the select's / datalist's options, 14 a table's rows, 15 a row's cells, 16 a table's tBodies, 17 a form's elements. Invalid_Argument for an unknown kind.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Collection_create :: proc(c: ^Call, root: Api_Node, kind: i32, arg: string) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#IntersectionObserver_takeRecords

bytes IntersectionObserver_takeRecords(u64 observer)

The entries waiting, 128 bytes each, little endian: target u64, time f64, intersectionRatio f64, flags u32 (bit 0 isIntersecting, bit 1 isVisible, bit 2 rootBounds is not null), 4 bytes of 0, then twelve f64: rootBounds, boundingClientRect and intersectionRect as x, y, width, height. Nothing changes until IntersectionObserver_release, so a call that did not fit can be made again.

Host: IntersectionObserver_takeRecords :: proc(c: ^Call, observer: u64) -> []u8
